title: Data Engineer
description:

title: Data Engineer

5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence

Knowledge of data architectures (data warehouses, lakehouse, and data mesh)

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s a plus)
Preferred
Databricks certification

title: Data Engineer

About Brighte
Our mission is to make consumer energy resources (CER) affordable and accessible for everyone.
Brighte is building the platform to enable and accelerate the energy transition by making it affordable, easy and less risky to buy and sell energy equipment.

As a business in 2025, we have been named a AFR Sustainability Leader within the Banking and Finance category and won the inaugural Sustainability Award at the Affies in 2024!
About the Role
As Brighte's Data Engineer, you'll own the infrastructure that keeps our data reliable, scalable, and AI-ready - our ELT pipelines (Airflow + dbt), Snowflake Data Warehouse, and data architecture.
You'll work closely with our Analytics Engineering and Analytics teams with one clear goal: high quality, traceable data that our business can trust and act on.
If you love solving infrastructure challenges and want to shape the future of a modern data stack, this role is for you.
What You'll Do
Develop and maintain Brighte’s data infrastructure
Maintain and augment ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) pipeline, our data architecture and relational data models
Implement testing suites and control mechanisms to ensure there is ‘a single source of truth’ for our business
Collaborate with our IT Operations team to maintain Snowflake platform administration
Take ownership of Snowflake database administration
Identify, define and implement data process improvements to generate value with existing and potential data sources
Champion a data-driven company culture
Architect for real time pipelines and AI use cases
Clearly communicate ideas and work to different stakeholders and identify opportunities for leveraging data to drive solutions

Technical skills
Snowflake — administration and hands-on use (must-have)
Airflow —hands-on use (must have)
AWS, and dbt or equivalent transformation framework (highly desired)
GitHub and CI/CD processes (desirable)

You bring an agile mindset you move fast without cutting corners, and you're comfortable juggling priorities in a dynamic environment
You're stakeholder savvy and know the difference between what people ask for and what they actually need, and you bridge that gap with ease
You're a strong communicator and can translate technical concepts for any audience, whether that's a data team or a business leader

Flexible working arrangements to suit individual needs and a hybrid work model. Our office is designed for collaboration, creativity and balance between office engagement and remote flexibility. We work in-office 3 days a week, 2 days WFH.

End-of-trip facilities. Cycle in to work, lock up your wheels and have a shower in our end-of-trip facilities, which come complete with towel service and hair dryers.
Anniversary leave - your dedication at Brighte won’t go unnoticed. Enjoy an extra day to celebrate your work anniversary with us.
Diversity and Inclusion
At Brighte, diversity isn’t just something we talk about, it’s something we live every day. We believe that innovation thrives when people feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work. Our inclusive culture is built on respect, collaboration, and the celebration of individuality.

title: Data Engineer

description:
About the Opportunity
The Office of the National Rail Safety Regulator (ONRSR) is looking for an experienced Data Engineer with a proven track record in designing, building and maintaining core data platforms and pipelines that will underpin regulatory insight, intelligence and decision-making.
Reporting to the Senior Manager Data Management and Platform, this role will focus on ensuring that the data collected, integrated and stored by ONRSR is reliable, secure, scalable and fit-for-purpose in the safety regulation context. In this newly formed role, you will have the opportunity to meaningfully contribute to a new, strategic operating model where data is key to regulatory decisions and outcomes. With strong relationships across the Safety and Regulatory Insights team, as well as other stakeholders, you will effectively translate regulatory and operational requirements into robust technical solutions that enable evidence-based regulation and safety improvement.
As the only organisation in Australia with a complete view of national rail safety performance, ONRSR is uniquely placed to provide safety insights. Leveraging your strengths and unique skillset, combined with your values-led approach to working and producing outcomes, the Data Engineer is responsible for ensuring reliability, availability and performance of data platforms supporting the enterprise data warehouse and advanced analytics use cases. You will apply a continuous improvement mindset, optimising data structures and performance to support analytics, reporting and intelligence.
If you are passionate about the transformative ability of data, information and insights while looking to have an impact on rail safety, this may be the role for you.
About you – your impact and contribution
In this role, you will translate complex regulatory and operational requirements into practical, scalable data solutions within a modern Microsoft Fabric environment, while taking ownership of data pipelines and platform components to ensure reliability, performance and maintainability. You will work closely with analysts and stakeholders to deliver data that is usable, trusted and well understood, leveraging Fabric capabilities to enable seamless data integration, modelling and access. You will also contribute to improving how data is structured, governed and consumed across the organisation, with a continuous focus on simplifying, optimising and modernising the data ecosystem.
Key to success in this role includes:  
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, demonstrating the capacity to effectively connect and communicate with a range of technical and non-technical stakeholders.  
Drive for, and skills to, building meaningful and effective relationships across the organisation.  
A commitment to continuous improvement, including own professional development as well as ways of working, contributing and producing outcomes for the organisation.  
Demonstrated experience in data engineering, including data pipelines, databases and integration technologies.  
A constructive approach to design solutions in complex, multi-source data environments.  
Understanding the importance of information security, privacy and risk considerations in government or regulated settings, including relevant governance obligations.
Experience using Apache Parquet and MS Fabric, as well as advanced knowledge and experience of SQL and working with heavily normalised data structures.

These are the dedicated employees who keep our world running – from baristas to nurses, cleaners to delivery drivers, florists to factory workers. Despite their vital role in society, most workplace technology has focused on those workers who sit behind a desk, but at Deputy, we transform the frontline. When businesses use Deputy, their workplaces thrive – the business is more profitable, compliant, and productive, while the workers are more engaged and happier at work.
 
We're becoming an AI-native company, a commitment that means you'll be empowered (and expected) to use AI tools and thinking in your day-to-day work. Responsibilities
Tool Orchestration: You are the Platform Owner for our Data Catalogue and Governance layer, ensuring seamless integration across the modern data stack and intelligent automation.
Taxonomy & Knowledge Graph: Design and maintain a universal Business Glossary and Technical Metadata schema. You will ensure that every asset has defined ownership, lineage, and semantic meaning. You will strategise how to scale and automate the underlying processes using AI (eg. AI-generated attribute definitions)
Data Discovery: Improve the "Time-to-Insight" by optimizing searchability and documentation, ensuring that downstream users can autonomously find and verify the data they need. You will leverage Agentic AI to enhance this autonomy with calculated risk of accuracy and consistency.
Quality-as-Code: Partner with Analytics Engineers to embed dbt tests and automated quality assertions into our CI/CD pipelines, aligning with the DAMA Data Quality dimensions (Accuracy, Completeness, Consistency, etc.).
Lineage & Impact Analysis: Utilize our data catalogue to monitor end-to-end data lineage, performing proactive impact analysis to ensure upstream changes don't break downstream "Sources of Truth."
Reference Data Management: Standardize reference data sets across our tech stack to ensure "one version of the truth" for dimensions like Currency, Geography, and Billing Structure.
Data Classification: Operationalise PII/Sensitive data identification. You will implement automated tagging and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) / Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to mitigate risk without slowing down analysis.
Stewardship & Accountability: Facilitate Data Stewardship by partnering with department heads to enable Data Owners, establishing clear RACI models for data domains.
Lifecycle Execution: Platform enablement of data lifecycle management across landing, transformation, and access data layers.
Skills & Experience
Experience: 2–5 years in Data Governance, Analytics Engineering, or Data Management. Familiarity with DAMA DMBOK frameworks is highly preferred.
Technical Mastery: Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with dbt (Data Build Tool). You must be able to read and audit transformation logic.
Applied AI: Proven experience of architecting and implementing intelligent automation and agentic AI patterns in processes and tooling
Governance Architecture: Proven experience implementing enterprise-grade catalogs such as Databricks Unity Catalog or similar (Alation, Collibra, DataHub).
Risk & Privacy Fluency: A technical understanding of how to map GDPR, SOC2, and ISO 27001 requirements to physical data structures and access patterns.
SaaS Ecosystems: Experience managing data flowing through high-volume integration tools like Fivetran, Stitch, or Airbyte.
Data Infrastructure: Databricks (Unity Catalog), AWS S3, Redshift.
Data Modeling: dbt (Core or Cloud), SQL.
Metadata/Governance: DataHub, Great Expectations, or Monte Carlo.
Domain Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Workforce Management data (HRIS, Payroll, and Core operational modules).
BI & Analytics: Looker, Thoughtspot, or Deputy Analytics+.

- Own A piece of Deputy via our Employee Share Ownership Plan (ESOP) 
- Take paid parental leave to support you and your family 
- Stay protected with Group Salary Continuance Insurance

- Enjoy additional leave days — including  study assistance, celebration days and volunteering

We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our team, working across the full AI and machine learning solution lifecycle from problem definition and design through to build, deployment, and optimisation.
This is more than a technical delivery role. We’re looking for someone who can combine strong engineering capability with sound judgement, commercial awareness, and a modern advisory mindset. Someone who can work closely with clients, understand real business challenges, and translate them into effective AI and ML solutions that are scalable, governed, and built for the real world.
What you’ll be doing
In this role, you’ll work with clients and internal teams to design, build, and deliver AI and machine learning solutions across a range of use cases and environments.
Your role:
Design, build, test, and deploy AI and ML solutions across the full lifecycle, from proof of concept through to production implementation
Apply modern AI/ML engineering practices, including data preparation, feature engineering, model and prompt development, deployment, monitoring, and optimisation
Translate business problems into practical AI and ML solutions, working directly with client data, technology, and business stakeholders
Embed responsible AI and governance controls into solution design and delivery, aligned to client risk, compliance, and ethical requirements
Contribute technical credibility to conversations around AI strategy, architecture, and governance
Support proposals, scoping, and capability assessments as part of business development activities
Develop reusable artefacts, patterns, and documentation to enable consistent and scalable delivery across engagements
Share knowledge and help uplift AI capability across the broader Altis team
Contribute to Altis AI intellectual property, thought leadership, and external market positioning as opportunities arise
What we’re looking for
We’re looking for someone who brings strong technical depth, end-to-end delivery experience, and the ability to work confidently with clients in complex environments.
What you ideally bring:
5+ years’ experience designing and delivering solutions in a commercial or consulting environment
Proven experience taking AI/ML solutions end-to-end, from problem definition and proof of concept through to production deployment and ongoing optimisation
The ability to assess a client problem and recommend the right approach, whether that is traditional machine learning, generative AI, or a combination of both
Experience working directly with clients and engaging with senior business and technology stakeholders
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear, practical business language
A strong understanding of responsible AI, including governance, risk, ethical considerations, and challenges such as hallucination, bias, and data privacy
Technical capability
You’ll bring strong hands-on capability across modern AI engineering practices and tooling, including:
Strong Python skills
Experience with data preparation, feature engineering, model development, and evaluation
Practical experience building LLM-powered solutions, including prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and agentic patterns such as tool use and multi-step reasoning
Familiarity with LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks, including context management, token economics, and cost optimisation
Experience with MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, model deployment, and performance monitoring in production
Familiarity with REST API design and integration patterns to connect AI solutions with client systems
Experience with AWS and/or GCP, containerisation, and CI/CD pipelines
Exposure to large-scale data processing, streaming, and workflow orchestration tools
Additional requirements
Regular domestic travel will be required to support client delivery and business development
The mindset that matters
Technical strength is essential, but it is only part of the picture.
We’re also looking for someone who brings:
A practical, solutions-focused approach
Strong judgement and the ability to navigate ambiguity
Curiosity and a genuine interest in emerging AI technologies
A collaborative mindset and willingness to share knowledge
The confidence to engage senior stakeholders and provide credible recommendations
A commitment to quality, responsible delivery, and continuous improvement
Why this role matters
This role sits at the heart of how we deliver AI outcomes for clients.
You’ll play a key role in shaping how AI solutions are designed, delivered, and scaled across engagements, while helping build Altis’ broader capability in a fast-moving and strategically important area. This is an opportunity to work on meaningful problems, influence client outcomes, and help define what good looks like in modern AI delivery.
Why join Altis?
At Altis, you’ll work with a team that values curiosity, innovation, and practical impact.
You’ll have the opportunity to solve real client challenges, contribute to the growth of our AI capability, and work across a mix of delivery, advisory, and capability-building activities. We’re a collaborative team that supports each other, encourages fresh thinking, and values people who can combine technical excellence with commercial and client awareness.
Your next chapter starts here
If you’re excited by the opportunity to design and deliver responsible, high-value AI solutions in a consulting environment, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Tech Lead
Build and deploy production ML & Data systems at scale - Work with cutting-edge ML technologies (LLMs, GenAI, Agentic AI) on real-world problems impacting millions of customers across Australia and New Zealand
Shape the future of retail with AI - Pioneer innovative ML solutions that transform how 24 million customers shop, from personalised recommendations to intelligent supply chain optimisation
Grow your craft - Collaborate with world-class Data Scientists and Engineers in an agile environment that values experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning
About us
We strive to create better experiences together for a better tomorrow for our customers and team, bringing the best of Woolworths Group and Quantium together to make data driven decisions. By partnering with Quantium, a world-class data science and advanced analytics business we're excited about the future as we unlock the power of data to reimagine retail.
Through this partnership, we've created a new business called WiQ who will harness the best of Woolworths Group and Quantium to reimagine retail by solving the most complex problems using data and analytics. As a team, we leverage Agile ways of working to help our team develop their skills while also making sure our team is focusing on solving the most complex problems for both our customers and team.
What you'll do
This is a unique opportunity for a technical leader with exposure to people management to help shape the future of data and AI at the core of WiQ. As a Lead Engineer, you will lead a talented team of 3-5 engineers, guiding their careers while remaining a deeply hands-on technical expert responsible for building our next generation of data and machine learning platforms.
You will architect and build the foundational data platforms and the intelligent ML systems that run on them. This role is for a "technical gun" with a deep command of software fundamentals who can design for scale, lead a team, and own the end-to-end delivery of complex data and ML solutions. If you are driven to build remarkable, high-performance systems and empower a team to do the same, this is the role for you.
Team & Technical Leadership: Lead, manage, and mentor a team of 3-5 Data and Machine Learning engineers. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous growth through rigorous code reviews, pair programming, and career development guidance.
Hands-On Development: Remain deeply hands-on, applying rock-solid software fundamentals to build robust data and ML pipelines, scalable APIs, and efficient data models. 
End-to-End Platform Ownership: Oversee the delivery of critical data and ML projects, ensuring timely completion while upholding high standards of quality, reliability, and performance. You will manage the team's roadmap, and ensure stakeholder expectations are met.
Drive Engineering & MLOps Excellence: Champion and implement best practices for both Data and ML engineering. This includes automated data quality frameworks, CI/CD for data and ML, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and advanced MLOps patterns (e.g., model monitoring, A/B testing, feature stores).
Strategic Contribution: Collaborate closely with Delivery Managers, Data Scientists, and senior leadership to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
What you'll bring
We are looking for a seasoned Technical leader with a strong problem-solving mindset and a passion for building high-performance systems and high-performing teams, while meeting business requirements across the Woolworths’ ecosystem.
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
8+ years of commercial software development experience
5+ years of hands-on experience with Python, SQL, and Linux
Experience building data pipelines using cloud technologies such as Vertex AI Pipelines, Apache Airflow, DBT or similar orchestration tools
Practical experience with MLOps/DevOps practices, including model deployment, monitoring, and automation
Experience with containerisation technologies like Docker and Kubernetes
Knowledge of microservices-oriented architecture and REST APIs
Experience in CI/CD pipeline setup (shell scripting, Unit/Integration Testing)
Proven communication and stakeholder management skills
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud (GCP) or other major cloud providers (AWS, Azure) is beneficial
Demonstrated experience with modern ML algorithms (e.g., GNN, LLM, GenAI, Agentic AI) or a strong passion to learn new skills is advantageous
What you’ll experience
 Our Team Members are at the heart of everything we do and we’re always looking for ways to support your career journey and reward great work:
Team discounts across our range of Woolworths Group brands you know and love and a robust rewards program that celebrates and incentivises purpose-driven work.
A global business with endless career possibilities around every corner and across every discipline – with valuable exposure to a vast and exciting business network.
High impact role supporting our teams who enrich our communities. 
A range of programs to help you prioritise and manage your wellbeing, including 24/7 access to the Sonder app.
A progressive and competitive leave policy that gives you more space for what matters to you.  
Endless possibilities with Woolworths Group
We’re a proud part of the Woolworths Group – 200,000+ bright minds, passionate hearts and unique perspectives working together connected by a shared Purpose – ‘to create better experiences together for a better tomorrow.’ 
Here you’ll be supported and empowered to explore new ideas, make brave commitments and innovate better ways to meet the food and everyday needs of more than 24 million customers every week. Backed by a culture of genuine care, a flexible approach to work and the support to grow your career and make a meaningful impact, the possibilities for what we can achieve together are endless.
Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group
Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.
We encourage all candidates to apply; please let us know in your application if we can support you with any adjustments in the hiring process.
